guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。
教學量化備忘：假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。
教學量化備忘：假設示意T=KdF，K=0.2、d=0.024 m、F=100 kN，T=480 N·m；非現場鎖付規格。
教學量化備忘：假設某區間ΔM=20 kN·m、Δθ=0.002 rad，割線增量剛度10 MN·m/rad；非全曲線常數。
教學量化備忘：假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。
教學量化備忘：假設環間剪力200 kN由4個有效連接區平均分擔，平均50 kN/區；實際分配仍可能偏心。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed T=KdF with K=0.2, d=0.024 m and F=100 kN, T=480 N·m, not a field tightening specification.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed ΔM=20 kN·m and Δθ=0.002 rad, incremental secant stiffness is 10 MN·m/rad, not a constant for the entire curve.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume 200 kN inter-ring shear shared equally by 4 effective connection zones; the mean is 50 kN per zone, with actual eccentric distribution unresolved.
timeline: 2009　美國聯邦公路管理局出版公路隧道土建手冊
2016　瑞士聖哥達基線隧道投入營運，提供長隧道背景對照
2017　Crossrail公開地質縱剖面完工更新與適用限制

landmarksEn: London Crossrail: public investigation and construction context
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：隧道管片接頭結構驗證
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Structural verification of segment joints
guides.concept: 本課聚焦用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
procedure: 接縫軸壓和彎矩共同決定接觸區，偏心增加會使一側壓力升高而另一側可能張開。把接縫當完整混凝土斷面會高估拉力傳遞，應先確定是否容許拉開及由哪些元件承擔拉力。 假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。 忽略偏心會低估局部壓碎，錯用完整斷面拉應力又會假設不存在的抗拉連續性；兩種誤用可能同時讓接縫看似剛硬且承載充足。
矩形接觸面在線性全壓條件下有核心範圍，偏心超出後會出現計算拉應力，表示全接觸假設需改變。這不是混凝土突然破壞，而是應轉成不承拉接觸及連接件共同作用模型。 假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。 接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。
鎖付扭矩透過螺紋和支承摩擦轉成預力，摩擦差異會讓同扭矩產生不同拉力。預力維持接觸但也增加局部荷載，不能將扭矩值本身當成已驗證的螺栓受力。 假設示意T=KdF，K=0.2、d=0.024 m、F=100 kN，T=480 N·m；非現場鎖付規格。 摩擦偏大時扭矩達標但預力不足，偏小時又可能過度拉伸；若接縫後續鬆弛未被追蹤，初始合格紀錄也不能證明長期接觸狀態。
接縫彎矩對轉角曲線通常隨接觸區縮小和螺栓啟動而改變斜率，不是一個固定彈簧。全環模型若使用等效剛度，必須說明載重範圍和軸力條件，避免把初始斜率外推到大轉角。 假設某區間ΔM=20 kN·m、Δθ=0.002 rad，割線增量剛度10 MN·m/rad；非全曲線常數。 固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。
結構接縫的轉角會在止水線位置放大或減少縫寬，水密檢核需要知道止水墊距轉動中心的距離。只看接縫中心位移可能漏掉邊緣張開，結構與防水模型必須使用相同幾何。 假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。 若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。
相鄰環錯開縱向接縫可改變彎矩與剪力傳遞，但效果取決於環間接觸、連接件與摩擦。不能把錯縫自動等同完整連續襯砌，施工階段尚未形成同樣約束時尤其需要分開分析。 假設環間剪力200 kN由4個有效連接區平均分擔，平均50 kN/區；實際分配仍可能偏心。 把環間完全黏結會高估荷載重分配能力，若某環接觸不足，原先假定的旁路傳力可能消失；單環試驗又不能直接證明多環錯縫效果。
列車、溫度或水壓變動使接縫反覆變形，螺栓預力可能鬆弛且接觸面磨耗。循環次數只有配合幅值、平均力和連接細節才有疲勞意義，不能單憑次數推斷必然破壞。 假設每日100次代表循環、30年、365日/年，總次數1,095,000；不含不同幅值合併。 用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。
螺栓或榫鍵把力集中輸入環片，周邊混凝土需要足夠錨定與劈裂控制。整體接縫力小不代表局部安全，孔位、公差和缺角會改變有效受力區，須結合構造細節檢查。 假設錨定區合力120 kN、有效受力面0.02 m²，名義應力6 MPa；不是混凝土局部承載驗算全式。 孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。
接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。足尺不代表所有邊界都正確，須區分試體變形、設備柔度與局部就位，才能用於模型校準。 假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。 設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。
接縫驗收需要連結結構、水密與組裝幾何，而不是三份互不對照的合格表。交接保存最不利組合、試驗覆蓋與剩餘假設，確保營運期檢查知道哪些裂縫或開合屬模型失效訊號。 假設10種設計組合中8種經直接試驗、2種靠分析外推，直接覆蓋80%；外推2種需明列限制。 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。
procedureEn: Compression and bending determine contact area. Increasing eccentricity raises pressure on one edge and may open the other. Treating the joint as monolithic concrete overstates tensile transfer unless the actual tension-carrying components are identified. Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry. Ignoring eccentricity understates local crushing, while monolithic tensile stress assumes nonexistent continuity. Together these mistakes can make a joint appear both stiffer and stronger than its actual contact permits.

A rectangular contact has a kern under linear compression. Beyond it, calculated tension signals loss of the full-contact assumption rather than immediate concrete failure, requiring no-tension contact and connector action to be modeled together. For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold. Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first.

Tightening torque becomes preload through thread and bearing friction, so equal torque can produce different tension. Preload maintains contact while adding local loads, making torque alone insufficient evidence of actual bolt force. For assumed T=KdF with K=0.2, d=0.024 m and F=100 kN, T=480 N·m, not a field tightening specification. High friction gives inadequate preload at the target torque, while low friction can overstrain the bolt. Untracked relaxation also means initial compliance does not prove sustained joint contact throughout service.

Moment-rotation behavior changes as contact shrinks and bolts engage, rather than remaining one constant spring. Equivalent ring-model stiffness therefore needs a stated moment range and axial force, preventing initial stiffness from being extrapolated to large rotation. For assumed ΔM=20 kN·m and Δθ=0.002 rad, incremental secant stiffness is 10 MN·m/rad, not a constant for the entire curve. A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint.

Joint rotation changes opening at the sealing line according to distance from the rotation center. Center displacement can miss edge opening, requiring structural and waterproofing models to share the same geometry and sign convention. Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening. An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket.

Staggering longitudinal joints changes bending and shear transfer through adjacent rings, depending on contact, connectors and friction. It does not automatically create a monolithic lining, especially before construction-stage restraints are established. Assume 200 kN inter-ring shear shared equally by 4 effective connection zones; the mean is 50 kN per zone, with actual eccentric distribution unresolved. Perfect inter-ring bonding overstates redistribution. Inadequate contact can remove an assumed alternate load path, while a single-ring test cannot directly demonstrate the effects of staggered multiring interaction in service.

Traffic, thermal and water-pressure cycles repeatedly deform joints, potentially relaxing preload and wearing contacts. Cycle count has fatigue meaning only alongside amplitude, mean force and connector detail, not as a standalone failure prediction. Assume 100 representative cycles per day for 30 years at 365 days/year; total count is 1095000, without combining different amplitude ranges. Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior.

Bolts and keys introduce concentrated forces requiring adequate anchorage and splitting control. Modest global joint force does not ensure local safety; hole location, tolerances and chips change the effective resisting region and must be checked with detailing. Assumed anchorage force 120 kN over effective area 0.02 m² gives nominal stress 6 MPa, not a complete local concrete-capacity check. Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete.

Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. Full size does not guarantee correct boundaries; separate specimen deformation, machine compliance and seating before calibrating a model. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence. Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis.

Joint acceptance links structural, waterproofing and assembly evidence rather than three unrelated pass sheets. Handover retains adverse combinations, test coverage and assumptions so operational inspections recognize signs invalidating the model. If 8 of an assumed 10 design combinations have direct testing and 2 rely on analysis, direct coverage is 80%; limits of the other 2 remain explicit. Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed.
evidence: 交接時逐項記錄軸力彎矩與偏心的資料來源與適用條件。以一致正負號繪製接縫N-M工況，對照全接觸、局部接觸和張開模型；用接縫試驗或核准數值分析驗證接觸範圍，不能只用混凝土抗壓值判定接縫安全。
交接時逐項記錄接觸核心與張開的資料來源與適用條件。量測接觸面尺寸及平整度，以壓敏材料或位移計檢查受載後接觸分布；分析中逐步檢視張開位置與螺栓受力，將幾何不完美納入而非只檢查名義矩形。
交接時逐項記錄螺栓預力與摩擦離散的資料來源與適用條件。由合格連接件試驗建立摩擦與預力關係，檢查潤滑狀態、批號及量測方法；現場依核准程序查核，必要時用直接或間接張力證據，不能照教學扭矩自行鎖付。
交接時逐項記錄轉動剛度與非線性的資料來源與適用條件。在多軸力情境試驗量測彎矩轉角及張開，區分初始、割線和卸載剛度；設計者應比較全環對不同剛度的敏感度，並保留接縫模型適用範圍與實驗來源。
交接時逐項記錄接縫轉角與止水張開的資料來源與適用條件。同時量測接縫中心和邊緣位移，與止水墊試驗包絡對照；結構及防水工程師確認轉角方向、偏心與錯台組合，不能用不同基準的兩份報告各自宣布合格。
evidenceEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for axial force bending and eccentricity. Plot joint N-M cases with consistent signs and compare full, partial and open-contact models; verify contact through tests or approved analysis rather than deciding joint adequacy from concrete compressive strength alone.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for contact kern and opening. Measure contact dimensions and flatness and observe loaded contact with appropriate film or gauges; track opening and bolt force in analysis, including imperfections rather than checking only a nominal rectangular surface.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for bolt preload and friction scatter. Establish friction-preload behavior through qualified connector testing with lubrication, batch and measurement records; field verification follows approved procedures and appropriate tension evidence, never the teaching torque as an instruction.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rotational stiffness and nonlinearity. Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness; designers assess ring sensitivity and retain the applicable range and experimental basis of each joint model.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint rotation and seal opening. Measure center and edge movement together and compare the gasket test envelope; structural and waterproofing engineers align rotation, eccentricity and offset combinations rather than separately approving reports with inconsistent geometry.
pitfalls: 忽略偏心會低估局部壓碎，錯用完整斷面拉應力又會假設不存在的抗拉連續性；兩種誤用可能同時讓接縫看似剛硬且承載充足。
摩擦偏大時扭矩達標但預力不足，偏小時又可能過度拉伸；若接縫後續鬆弛未被追蹤，初始合格紀錄也不能證明長期接觸狀態。
若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。
用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。
設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。
pitfallsEn: Ignoring eccentricity understates local crushing, while monolithic tensile stress assumes nonexistent continuity. Together these mistakes can make a joint appear both stiffer and stronger than its actual contact permits.

High friction gives inadequate preload at the target torque, while low friction can overstrain the bolt. Untracked relaxation also means initial compliance does not prove sustained joint contact throughout service.

An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket.

Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior.

Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道管片防水墊圈安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「軸力彎矩與偏心」與「循環載重與鬆弛」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Axial force bending and eccentricity" and "Cyclic loading and relaxation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Segmental-lining gasket installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫；隧道管片防水墊圈安裝則以把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior; Segmental-lining gasket installation centres on connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「軸力彎矩與偏心」與「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道管片防水墊圈安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「黏貼與表面相容」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Axial force bending and eccentricity” and “Compression and groove geometry”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Segmental-lining gasket installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Bonding and surface compatibility", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道管片接頭結構驗證
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
